title: Retrocompact evaluation-isomorphism open inside a rank-matched locus
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ satisfy the flat, proper, finite-presentation and universal structure-pushforward assumptions [def-weil-flat-morphism] [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and let $\mathcal E$ be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Let $j:W\to S$ be any morphism such that $P(f,\mathcal E,h\circ j)$ holds for every $h:T\to W$ [def-sc-picard-direct-image-rank-condition]. There is a quasi-compact open immersion $k:Z\to W$ such that $h$ factors through $k$ if and only if the adjunction counit $p^*p_*q^*\mathcal E\to q^*\mathcal E$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] is invertible, for the base change of $f$ along $h\circ j$.

source.place: final two paragraphs of the proof: cup-product dual bases and the retrocompact determinant open

proof.text: The explicit universal rank and canonical base-change condition gives two finite locally free direct images N and D of the same rank r, locally on W, and identifies their pullbacks with the direct images over every test scheme. The pushforward of evaluation and the structure-pushforward identification give the cup-product pairing N tensor D to O_W.

In local frames take the determinant of the transpose D to N-dual of this pairing. Frame changes multiply the determinant by a unit. Its principal opens glue to a retrocompact open Z of W. Factorization through Z is equivalent to perfection of the pairing after arbitrary base change.

A perfect pairing gives local dual bases whose evaluations are the identity matrix. They define inverse maps between q*E and p*N: a split map of free modules of the same rank is invertible. The first map is the canonical adjunction counit. Conversely an invertible counit gives q*E isomorphic to p*N; the local finite-free projection calculation identifies D with N-dual and the pairing with evaluation. Hence the determinant criterion is equivalent to the displayed counit condition. The rank-zero determinant is 1 and the empty base is vacuous.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picardEvaluationOpenLocus {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    {W : Scheme.{u}} (j : W ⟶ S)
    (hW : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ W), PicardDirectImageRankCondition f E (h ≫ j)) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (k : Z ⟶ W), IsOpenImmersion k ∧ QuasiCompact k ∧
      ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ W),
        (∃ l : T ⟶ Z, l ≫ k = h) ↔
          IsIso ((Classical.choose
            (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f (h ≫ j)))).counit.app
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ j))).obj E))
